تحتفوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفُوا (taḥtafū) /taħ.ta.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# تُحْتَفَوْا (tuḥtafaw) /tuħ.ta.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
